title: Yeast transformation \(for LexA library screen)
protocol: Streak yeast cell EGY48 with p8op-lacZ reporter plasmid on SD-Ura plate for 3-5 days at 30°C.
Scrape an entire colony (2-3 mm in diameter) into 1 ml of YPD medium.
Vortex vigorously to disperse any clumps.
Transfer the mixture into a flask containing YPD: Small Scale - 50 ml in 250 ml flask, Library Scale - 150 ml in 500 ml flask.
Incubate at 30°C overnight (16-18 hr) with shaking (at 250 rpm).
Transfer overnight culture enough to produce an OD600=0.2-0.3 into this volume of YPD: Small Scale - 300 ml in 1L flask, Library Scale - 1000 ml in 2L flask.
Incubate at 30°C for 3 hr with shaking (230 rpm).
Place cells in 50-ml tubes and centrifuge at 1500 rpm in floor centrifuge for 5 min at room temperature.
Discard the supernatant and resuspend cell pellets by vortexing in this volume of sterile TE or H2O: Small Scale - 25-50 ml, Library Scale - 500 ml.
Pool cells in 50 ml tube and centrifuge at 1500 rpm in floor centrifuge for 5 min at room temperature.
Decant the supernatant.
Resuspend the cell pellet in this volume of freshly prepared, sterile 1xTE/LiAc: Small Scale - 1.5 ml, Library Scale - 8 ml.
Prepare PEG/LiAc solution.
Reconstitute bait vector with 0.2 μg for small scale or 0.6 mg for library scale.
Add library vector to each tube with 0.1 μg for small scale or 0.3 mg for library scale.
Mix herring testes carrier DNA denatured by boiling and immediately cooling on ice, using 0.1 mg for small scale or 20 mg for library scale.
Add yeast competent cells to each tube: use 0.1 ml for small scale or 8 ml for library scale.
Vortex the tubes well after adding yeast competent cells.
Add sterile PEG/LiAc solution made in step #9, using 0.6 ml for small scale or 60 ml for library scale.
Incubate at 30°C with shaking (200 rpm) for 30 minutes.
Add DMSO: use 70 μl for small scale or 7 ml for library scale and mix gently by inversion or swirling.
Heat shock the tubes in a 42°C water bath for 15 minutes, swirl occasionally if large or library scale is used.
Chill cells on ice for 1-2 minutes.
Centrifuge cells at room temperature: use 5 seconds at 14K rpm for small scale or 5 minutes at 1500 rpm for library scale.
Remove the supernatant from each tube.
Resuspend cells in 1 x TE: use 0.5 ml for small scale or 10 ml for library scale.
Spread 200 μl per 100-mm SD-Ura-His-Trp plate for small-scale cotransformation.
Spread 100 μl each of a 1:1,000, 1:100, and 1:10 dilution on SD-Ura-His-Trp plates (100 mm) for cotransformation efficiency controls.
Spread 1 μl diluted in 100 μl of H2O on SD-His-Ura and SD-Trp-Ura plates (100 mm) to check transformation efficiency of each plasmid.
Spread the remaining transformation suspension on SD-Ura-His-Trp plates (200 μl per 150-mm plates).
Incubate the plates at 30°C for 3-5 days.
